context: A chef and barista plan a summer menu
purpose: Teach: 太陽光/リモコン/ヘア/サマー/水着/コーラス/熱中/ナチュラル

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、夏フェア、太陽光発電と連動した節電メニュー、考えよか。
lines.en: Aoi-san, what do you think about putting together a summer fair menu that ties in with the solar panels—something energy-conscious?
lines.style: Warm, energetic opening. Leans forward with enthusiasm. Kansai lilt on the interrogative. Inviting her into the idea, not proposing from above.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。冷房リモコン、設定温度、調整します。
lines.en: Sure. I can adjust the AC temperature settings from the remote.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment. No flourish. The tone of someone already thinking three steps ahead, accepting the work as natural.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 店内のヘアサロン棟、合同企画、ええなあ。
lines.en: The salon wing here doing something together—that could work really well.
lines.style: Appreciative, almost relieved. Voice settles into the idea like it's clicking into place. Slight knowing warmth, as if this was the right move all along.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: サマーコレクションのカップ、限定で出しましょう。
lines.en: We could put out the summer-collection cups as a limited run.
lines.style: Bright, forward-moving. Picks up energy. Concrete suggestion offered without waiting to be asked. Light and purposeful.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 水着姿のお客様向けに、屋外席、用意しよ。
lines.en: And we'll set up some outdoor seating for guests in swimwear.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact. Takes the practical step like checking boxes. No hesitation—just the next logical thing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: コーラス系のBGM、爽やかですよね。
lines.en: The chorus-style background music is really refreshing for this kind of vibe.
lines.style: Observant, almost dreamy. Notices the small details that make an atmosphere work. Soft voice, seeing the whole picture.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 熱中症予防に、おしぼり配ろか。
lines.en: And we should hand out cool towels to help with heatstroke prevention.
lines.style: Shifts to protective care. The tone of someone thinking about the guests' bodies, not just the aesthetics. Grounded, responsible.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ナチュラル素材の食器、エコ的にも訴求できます。
lines.en: Natural-material dishware works too—we can lean on the eco-angle.
lines.style: Warm, satisfied conclusion. Brings it all together. Gentle confidence that this will land well. Small smile in the voice.
